description: Record IDs are unique; no output row is lost or duplicated by the transform.
Input/output row totals match and zero rows were dropped.
Every cleaned output column is checked against its declared logical type.
USD to EGP/SAR annual salary conversions match the frozen date-specific cross rates.
For every annual salary with a range, minimum <= point estimate <= maximum.
Skill JSON arrays agree with their recorded token/ID counts.
An update timestamp is not silently promoted to a posting timestamp.
Every synthetic estimate has an explicit synthetic method, source note and status.
Not-disclosed and unparseable values are not filled by the imputation model.
Project SQLite job and job-skill counts agree with the cleaned source rows / skill assignments.
